issues.quote: Monnier had made us all show our watches, as he does every year, and told me my case wanted cleaning and my hands were a disgrace.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about watches being shown, compared, or checked against one another, or about how accurate Girard's watch is.
issues.misreading: A solver could infer that Girard's watch was checked and set against the others, so its readings are reliable. That bears on every watch reading in the puzzle, though no individual reading changes.

issues.quote: A merchant notices time, Inspector. It is what we sell.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no reason to think Girard's watch is accurate or that he is a careful timekeeper.
issues.misreading: Read with the watch-showing remark, this line suggests Girard's watch is trustworthy. That is an unsupported hint about clock reliability, not a reading.
